title: Triangle Shirtwaist Factory Fire
summary: On 25 March 1911 a fire began on the eighth floor of the Asch Building in New York City, at the Triangle Waist Factory. Within 18 minutes 146 people were dead, making it the city's deadliest industrial disaster and prompting demands for stronger workplace safety protections.

uncertainty.note: NPS gives the date as March 25, 1911; the Cornell page gives the same date in styled capitals.
